Ganga ghat cleanup drive covers 40 locations

A coordinated cleanup drive across 40 ghats of the Ganga in Patna and neighbouring districts began on Sunday ahead of the Chhath festival.

Municipal workers, NDRF personnel and volunteer groups removed plastic waste, water hyacinth and silt deposited during the monsoon.

Officials said temporary changing rooms, drinking water stations and lighting are being installed at major ghats before the festival.

Environmentalists urged devotees to avoid single-use plastics and use designated immersion ponds for offerings.

The drive will continue daily until the conclusion of the festival, officials added.
